query: creaseNormals
rationale: Exact current helper name should resolve without unrelated smoothing operations outranking it.

query: createJointChain local bend axis end effector
rationale: The named chain helper owns the rest-frame, axis and end-effector descriptors requested.

query: normalMapFromHeight strength
rationale: Exact helper lookup with an actual option; material factories do not derive the normal pixels.

query: Keep the lip sharp but shade the sides smoothly without losing texture corners
rationale: Angle-limited normals preserve sharp transitions and UV corners without changing the shape through subdivision.

query: A stretched pill lying front to back, with hemispherical ends
rationale: Kiln's forward axis is X, and this capsule has the requested rounded caps in that orientation.

query: A tyre and hub that turn together at the axle while the whole wheel can steer
rationale: The assembly supplies concentric wheel parts, an axle spin pivot and an optional steering pivot. A geometry-only wheel set does not supply that behavior.

query: Lay corrugated strips down the direction rain runs on either side of a pitched roof
rationale: The layout consumes a roof face's downhill frame; the gable-roof helper is the direct source of those frames.

query: Turn a bottle outline into a closed volume that I can subtract another solid from
rationale: Solid revolution meets the closed-volume requirement. Surface-only lathe/revolve helpers do not guarantee a boolean-ready solid.

query: Carry an L-shaped cross section around a bent handrail route
rationale: A noncircular profile swept along path stations is the supported operation. Circular tube helpers discard the specified section.

query: Bridge several matching polygon outlines at different positions into one capped transition
rationale: Corresponding equal-count profiles with explicit frames are the loft contract. The wording deliberately supplies correspondence.

query: I have an equation mapping two parameters to xyz and want a sampled surface with texture coordinates
rationale: The two-parameter sampler produces positions and UVs; an implicit scalar-field extractor is a different input contract.

query: qadratic bezeir control ponts to sampled path
rationale: Misspelled quadratic Bezier terminology should retrieve the control-point-to-path sampler.

query: extrdue profle with interor cutout
rationale: The intended solid extrusion supports interior holes despite three common spelling errors.

query: unlit materal ignores scene ligths
rationale: The request is unlit shading, not an emissive PBR surface still affected by other lighting terms.

query: booleen intersecion keep only overlapping volume
rationale: The retained region is explicitly the intersection, not a union or subtraction.

query: Count boundary and nonmanifold edges after matching duplicated seam positions
rationale: Topology diagnostics use position-based seam matching. This asks for counts, not an unsupported proof of a valid solid.

query: Declare support and propulsion sockets for a boat with no wheels
rationale: The semantic frame supports non-wheeled vehicles through declared support and propulsion sockets.

query: Extract a level set from a positive-inside gyroid scalar field in a finite box
rationale: Positive-inside signed sampling with explicit spatial bounds is the implicit-surface contract; a parametric UV sampler is different.

query: Impostor atlas quad whose shader chooses the view-dependent tile
rationale: This quad pre-scales UVs to one atlas tile and expects the consuming shader to offset them. It does not itself implement view selection.

query: Drill recesses into a painted body while retaining its existing UV and material attributes
rationale: Subtraction with attribute preservation is the direct operation. Re-atlasing is not an equivalent way to retain the existing UVs.

query: Generate seamless brick pixels and derive a tiling tangent-space bump normal from their brightness
rationale: The layer generator supplies deterministic tiling brick pixels; the height-to-normal helper supplies the separate normal map.

query: Cheap crossed leaf cards with alpha cutouts visible from both sides
rationale: Crossed quads supply the explicit card arrangement and the foliage material supplies MASK alpha and double-sided shading.

query: Package translation and degree-based joint rotation keyframes into a named animation
rationale: The two track helpers express the channels and the clip helper packages them. A fixed spin or bob preset is not sufficient for authored keyframes.

query: ring
rationale: A ring can reasonably mean a three-dimensional donut or a circular two-dimensional outline. No solid/open-profile constraint was provided.

query: spin around an axis
rationale: The short phrase could mean animate rotation or construct a surface/solid of revolution. Relevant alternatives should expose that distinction.

query: Change one part's roughness without changing the other parts, but keep the image maps shared
rationale: An owned material copy with shared texture references meets the request. Geometry copying and the retired identity alias do not.

query: Pack arbitrary mesh islands for a non-repeating baked texture; chart rotation is fine
rationale: This specifically permits an atlas for a baked image. Directional primitive UV preservation and planar projection are not equivalent.

query: Bevel only the selected edges of my existing arbitrary triangle mesh
rationale: Current rounded-box and profile-bevel constructors do not bevel selected edges of arbitrary existing meshes; subdivision is smoothing, not this operation.

query: Solve inverse kinematics so an articulated foot follows a moving ground target
rationale: The catalog supplies joint graphs and keyframe construction, not an IK solver or target-following controller.

query: Certify that an arbitrary mesh has absolutely no self intersections
rationale: The current diagnostics explicitly do not certify self-intersection freedom; closed edges alone are insufficient.

query: Load a texture straight from any HTTPS image URL inside build
rationale: Sandbox texture loading accepts approved resource IDs, not arbitrary URLs. Returning that restricted loader as satisfying this request would hide a contract mismatch.

query: Measure the actual GPU draw calls by counting unique material objects
rationale: Unique material count is not a draw-call measurement. No listed helper provides the requested actual GPU measurement through that method.

query: Repeat tilted slats in a straight row, nine total including the one already placed
rationale: Linear repetition preserves orientation and counts the unchanged source as the first of nine.

query: A tight convex envelope enclosing several pieces for a faceted collision proxy
rationale: The convex hull encloses all input geometry; a boolean union follows concavities and is not a convex envelope.
